contract.bounds: [A/N,(A+M)/N]; sharp finite-cohort bounds assuming known labels correct, not confidence intervals
contract.controls: naive binary likelihood explicitly collapses unknown into nonadvanced, diagnostic only
contract.definition_policy: Preserve each HASP report's AHD definition; do not relabel to current WHO thresholds or pediatric definitions.
contract.evaluation: expanding event-time blocks AND declared-mirror-availability blocks; same three-category targets for every family
contract.freeze: R41 and R97 Q4 forecasts unchanged; no prior run overwritten
contract.profile: profile separate q_A,q_E for each evidence quarter; no pseudo-counts or handmade hazard weights
contract.role_gate: only accepted auxiliary_likelihood classification rows; annual incidence excluded
contract.scope: national reported AHD classification; not incidence or diagnosis-delay identification
contract.score: mean per-case multinomial deviance, equally weighted quarters; conditional on target N, not an unconditional count forecast
contract.selection: no champion selection from this small diagnostic experiment
contract.source: R97 locked report catalog; first-page quarterly HASP footnotes
contract.unknown_policy: Unknown is not nonadvanced. Accept only explicit Of these containment and exact count reconciliation.

gate.claim_limit: Classification likelihood diagnostic only; no epidemic, intervention, regional or AEM superiority claim
